skillData.title: All the skills that I have in the field of work are mentioned.
skillData.text: I am a Senior Software Engineer at Capgemini with strong expertise in backend development using Java, Spring Boot, and microservices architecture. I have led the design and implementation of LLM-powered RAG systems using tools like LangChain and LlamaIndex, enhancing customer engagement through intelligent chatbot solutions. Proficient in building scalable APIs, optimizing PostgreSQL databases, and deploying services using Docker and Kubernetes. On the frontend, I specialize in ReactJS and Redux to deliver responsive and high-performance user interfaces. I’ve also driven the adoption of Generative AI across projects using AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, and performance evaluation frameworks like MLflow and RAGAS. Known for exceeding expectations in Agile teams, I consistently deliver innovative, production-ready solutions.
